prompt_text:
Continue the given text:
You're Barack Obama. 4 years into your retirement, you awake to find a letter with no return address on your bedside table. It reads "I hope you've had a chance to relax Barack...but pack your bags and call the number below. It's time to start the real job." Signed simply, "JFK."
reference_text: This was strange, because I, Barack Obama, had just recently been thinking that I would like to pack my bags and go on an adventure. I don't know how JFK had known this, or why he might have taken it upon himself to have me rousted out of my retirement, but...wait.

instruction.label: right but not left
instruction.rule: Using the first separator as the split, at least one tracked phrase ('recently', 'adventure', 'upon', 'strange', 'known', 'thinking', 'might', 'taken', 'know', 'like', 'pack', 'retirement', 'bags', 'himself', 'why', 'because') must occur on the right and not on the left.
